tier: Small / Large / XLarge always-on agent instance

free_tier.stated: No free tier. A time-boxed trial credits the first 5 days of hosting to the wallet when Mue is chosen on a Small or Large instance, once per account; otherwise Small is USD 2.88 a month, Large USD 5.25, XLarge USD 7.90, prorated.
free_tier.notes: The 5-day Mue credit is a trial, not a free tier: it is once per account, excludes XLarge, and does not apply to OpenClaw or Hermes. The paid instance price is per agent, always on, prorated to the time the agent exists.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an always-on instance, not an object; the largest disk is 20 GB NVMe on the XLarge size

retention.stated: A versioned workspace keeps the history of every file and config change; a stopped agent costs 10x less with the workspace kept, and a deleted agent costs nothing.

egress.terms: Network fees are zero in and out: '$0 network fees, in or out'.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited: $0 network fees in or out

interface_detail: Console in the browser, SSH access, the API and a public HTTPS address for every agent, per the pricing page.
tooling: the Molted dashboard and API; SSH into the instance; a terminal in the browser; an agent with an API key or subscription supplies the model
chaining: An always-on agent host with a persistent workspace, browser and integrations; it pairs with object storage for artifacts that must outlive a deleted agent, and its model usage is billed by the provider on the user's own key or subscription.

limits.value: 5 days of hosting credited to the wallet once per account when Mue is chosen on Small or Large; XLarge, OpenClaw and Hermes excluded
20 GB NVMe storage on the XLarge size; 5 GB Small, 10 GB Large

limits_note: Amounts are prorated: three days of Large cost about $0.53; a stopped agent costs 10x less with the workspace kept; a deleted agent costs nothing. Paid tools are debited from a prepaid wallet under a spending cap, with automatic top-up from $15.
binding_note: The 5-day Mue credit is the only free amount and is one-time, so the paid monthly instance price applies to any sustained use.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page reads 'Create your account' and asks Region, Organization, 'Your name', 'Work email', Website, and agreement to the Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy. No phone, ID document, institution or card field appears on the signup page. The prepaid wallet's top-up method (card?) is unverified: behind a sign-up and is not stated on any page read.

reliability_note: Instances are always on with monitoring and four recovery tiers for automatic repair; Molted states the '2x faster per core' figure is an internal measurement, median of three runs, not an independent benchmark.
confidence_note: The rate card, the 5-day Mue credit and its exclusions, the zero network fees and the signup fields are quoted from Molted's own pricing and signup pages read on 2026-11-24.

evidence.proved: the 5-day free hosting credit is a Mue-only trial on Small or Large, once per account, excluding XLarge and other runtimes
evidence.quote: Pick Mue as your runtime on a Small or Large instance and your first 5 days of hosting are credited to your wallet, once per account. The offer is for Mue only and does not apply to XLarge. OpenClaw and Hermes are billed from the first day, prorated.

extras.billing_model: per-agent monthly, prorated; prepaid wallet for usage
